Recursive sum of a list
examples.original_code:
sum :: [Int] -> Int
sum []     = 0
sum (x:xs) = x + sum xs

examples.title: Insertion sort
examples.original_code:
for i = 1 to n-1:
  key = A[i]
  j = i - 1
  while j >= 0 and A[j] > key:
    A[j+1] = A[j]
    j = j - 1
  A[j+1] = key

examples.title: Quicksort with Lomuto partition
examples.original_code:
partition(A, lo, hi):
  pivot = A[hi]
  i = lo - 1
  for j = lo to hi-1:
    if A[j] <= pivot: i++, swap A[i], A[j]
  swap A[i+1], A[hi]
  return i+1
